🚨 BREAKING: India reports its first case of HMPV virus in Bengaluru.

An 8-month-old baby with no travel history has tested positive. The child was admitted to the hospital with fever, and blood tests confirmed the virus.

The case has been reported to the Union Health Ministry. https://t.co/7O32olFZV0
